name: 25741-prefillheavy-qwen8b-1gpu
model: Qwen/Qwen3-8B, bf16, unquantized, ungated on HF. ~8.2 B parameters, ~16 GB of weights on one card.
hardware: 1x H100 80GB HBM3, one card of one a3 node. No router, no external cache tier, no second node.
parallelism: TP=1, PP=1, DP=1, no expert parallelism, no speculative decoding, no disaggregation. One rank, one process.
architecture: Qwen3ForCausalLM, dense decoder-only, full attention on every layer; the rest is in the checkpoint's own config.json.
load_profile: concurrent (closed loop), streams=64, warmup the first 25%, bounded at 2400 requests with an 1800 s safety cap.
workload: guidellm `synthetic_text`, single turn, no shared prefix, streaming. 1200 prompt tokens (stdev 32) against 32 output tokens (stdev 0), temperature 0.0, seed 42.
purpose: An 8-billion-parameter summarizer condensing page-length documents into one-line gists for 64 concurrent streaming users on one GPU.
launch:
# The launch config, in `sglang serve` CLI form.
#
# FLAT PARSER: one `key: value` per line. A nested block is dropped silently, which would run the
# engine without something this file declares. Every key below is a real ServerArgs field at the
# pinned commit; a key borrowed from a later release fails at start-up.

model-path: Qwen/Qwen3-8B
tp-size: 1
chunked-prefill-size: 2048
max-prefill-tokens: 2048
mem-fraction-static: 0.87
cuda-graph-max-bs: 128
random-seed: 42
